papers.title: Attention Is All You Need
papers.abstract: We propose a new simple network architecture, the Transformer, based solely on attention mechanisms, dispensing with recurrence and convolutions entirely.

papers.title: Neural Machine Translation by Jointly Learning to Align and Translate
papers.abstract: We introduce an attention mechanism that allows the model to search for parts of a source sentence that are relevant to predicting a target word.

papers.title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
papers.abstract: BERT uses a bidirectional Transformer encoder and is pre-trained with masked language modeling.

papers.title: Language Models are Few-Shot Learners
papers.abstract: GPT-3 scales autoregressive language models and evaluates few-shot learning without task-specific fine-tuning.
